rules.objective_policy: Keep all targets in reserved block excluded from development evaluation.
rules.x_y_key_separation: Keep predictors, labels and linkage keys separated in all artifacts.

metrics.event_definition: Onset at target S requires observed excess(S)=1 and observed excess(S-1)=0 for the same municipality and exactly the previous calendar month.
metrics.anticipation: One-step issuance: each prediction is evaluated at its own target period (t+h).
metrics.evaluable_population: All selected keys retained. True onset denominator depends only on evaluable scientific S/S-1 states, never prediction availability.
metrics.unknown_periods_treatment: Unknown/missing scientific S or S-1 is explicitly counted/excluded from real-onset evaluability. Missing alerts retain true onsets in denominator; sensitivity value is unavailable and detected/all-real-onsets is an explicitly named lower bound.
metrics.average_precision_definition: Non-interpolated AP = sum over distinct descending score thresholds of recall increment times precision; tied scores enter together.
metrics.event_context_source: Hash-verified Stage3 development keys/features, scientifically approved zona_canal_t at S and S-1; no recalculation of Y/channel/percentiles.
metrics.event_context_scope: Only selected development target months S and required S-1 (which may precede the validation window); never use origin state as S-1 for T+2.
metrics.invalid_prediction_policy: Misalignment, malformed/nonfinite numbers, nonbinary labels or out-of-range probabilities raise. Missing required predictions make AP/Brier/alert ratios non-evaluable for the whole selected population with missing counts; no silent complete-case ranking.
metrics.event_information_boundary: Retrospective evaluation_context.csv is never X, fitting data, hyperparameter search data or threshold-selection input.
metrics.probabilistic_event_metrics: Without a declared threshold policy, event metrics and detection lower bounds are unavailable; actual onset counts remain reported separately.

determinism_limits: No candidate model stochastic training in this delivery.
Deterministic references depend on zone state availability and valid temporal linkage.
Notebook receipts depend on kernel package versions.

selection_policy.authority: Explicit Mauricio instruction in corrective request, 2026-10-20; DEC-123.
selection_policy.technical_eligibility: Reject runs with leakage, invalid/unavailable required predictions, key/cohort misalignment or unverifiable artifacts before considering scores.
selection_policy.hyperparameters: Maximize arithmetic mean AP across declared temporal inner-training splits only; all fitted steps stay within each inner-training split.
inner_tiebreak: Minimize mean Brier on the same inner splits for probabilistic candidates.
Prefer simpler configuration under the predeclared within-family lexicographic rule.

numeric_ties.rule: Form ties within absolute tolerance of the best AP; among them within tolerance of the best (minimum) Brier. This is a fixed computational rule, not statistical equivalence.

simplicity.comparison: Within family only; compare the following tuples lexicographically, smallest first. Normalize unlimited depth to positive infinity. If tuples tie, retain a scientific tie and use canonical configuration ID only for reproducible display.
simplicity.prerequisite: Declare supported parameters, basis counting and search grid before any future search. Noncomparable regularization or different families remain tied on complexity; no arbitrary cross-family score.

selection_policy.external_comparison: Separate T+1 and T+2 rankings using equal-weight arithmetic mean AP over all four external windows, with candidate configurations fixed before viewing external results. Do not omit inconvenient/invalid windows.
selection_policy.events: Onset sensitivity and false alarms require a declared threshold policy and are not combined into an arbitrary weighted selection score.
selection_policy.external_boundary: No repeated candidate/hyperparameter/threshold adjustment to external validation; final reserved block from2025-01 remains untouched.
selection_policy.reference_boundary: This delivery emits diagnostic reference metrics only, no ranking mixing deterministic persistence with probabilistic references or candidates.
selection_policy.gate_boundary: Stage4 ranking is not an approved Stage5 champion; no model adapters/search implemented by this correction.

xgboost_candidate.execution_policy: reuse verified identical identity; never refit on verify
